description: This file defines an Interval class and related functions for creating, manipulating, and analyzing intervals, including merging, intersection, union, complement, and containment checks. It appears to be part of a larger system for interval arithmetic or set operations.

classes.name: Interval
classes.description: Represents a union of atomic intervals with methods for creation, manipulation, and set operations.

methods.name: mergeable
methods.description: Checks if two atomic intervals can be merged based on overlap or adjacency.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Creates an open interval with specified bounds.

methods.name: closed
methods.description: Creates a closed interval with specified bounds.

methods.name: openclosed
methods.description: Creates a left-open interval with specified bounds.

methods.name: closedopen
methods.description: Creates a right-open interval with specified bounds.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Creates a singleton interval with a single value.
